questions.prompt: Akbar the Great expanded which South Asian empire?
questions.fact: He abolished the tax on non-Muslim subjects and hosted debates between scholars of rival faiths at his court.

questions.prompt: Which gas is essential for combustion?
questions.fact: Fire needs it, fuel and heat together, which is why removing any one of the three puts a fire out.

questions.prompt: The Fosbury Flop transformed technique in which event?
questions.fact: It only became practical once landing pits changed from sand and sawdust to deep foam.

questions.prompt: Which musician released the albums Lemonade and Renaissance?
questions.fact: Renaissance was framed as the first act of a trilogy, and leaned heavily on house and ballroom traditions.

questions.prompt: What is the capital of Chile?
questions.fact: It sits in a valley ringed by mountains, which traps air pollution during the winter months.

questions.prompt: Who wrote 'On the Origin of Species'?
questions.fact: The first print run sold out on the day of publication, and the word evolution barely appears in it.

questions.prompt: Which company operates the Azure cloud platform?
questions.fact: It was announced in 2008 under a different name and renamed two years later.
